summary: The change adds a 24-hour window to the replay check in payments.release, so a replayed instruction more than a day old sends a second disbursement to core banking. This violates PAY-2 (released at most once). No exception in the register covers it, and the earlier PAY-2 acceptance evidence has lapsed under LAP-1 with nothing to replace it. Ticket, independent approval and approval-on-head are in order, and the CI record shows a green suite on the head commit, though the only PAY-2 control test is a same-instant sample that cannot catch the defect. The change must be rejected.
